   - Added a new entry documenting the bug fix related to the Oozie Spark action ignoring `spark.executor.extraJavaOptions` and `spark.driver.extraJavaOptions`.

The modifications in `SparkMain.java` directly address the bug described in the release log. The changes ensure that the Spark action correctly processes the `spark.executor.extraJavaOptions` and `spark.driver.extraJavaOptions` by dynamically appending the Log4J configuration only if it hasn't been set already. This prevents overwriting existing configurations and provides a warning to the user, enhancing the robustness of the Spark action in Oozie. The entry in `release-log.txt` serves to document this fix, linking the code changes to the specific issue (OOZIE-2705) that was resolved.
